node.statement: The display row's fiber-aggregated masses are exactly the pinned masses: c^{(v)}_v = c_v = 1 - tau, c^{(v)}_w = c_w = tau + t, c^{(v)}_f = c_f = -t, and c^{(v)}_Q = 0 for every other full row-point fiber Q, by the hypothesis on top-row fiber masses.
